authorizationBasis.meaning: Project-owner authorization to publish is separate from creator license grants. Apply this publication authorization only to the exact70 independently evidenced licensed recordings. It does not establish UA-FPV permissions or listening approval.

exactRecordingSelection.meaning: All70 rows, with no additions/substitutions. The full pinned source manifest contains each exact runtime path, byte count and SHA256; the independently checked authorization lists the identical70 IDs and runtime hashes.

evidenceMethod: All70 rows were checked against the retained same-day creator-license evidence and hash-bound production policy. Current primary pages below were additionally opened during this publication audit for license terms, historical conflicts and specific attribution requirements. No audio downloaded, changed, listened to, or published by this audit.
publicationConditions: Retain title, credited creator/attribution parties, source URL, selected license name and clickable license URL, and any supplied copyright/disclaimer notices. Keep these accessible with public previews and redistributed downloads/packs.

For CC BY works, keep relevant change notices and make no additional legal/technical reuse restrictions or implication of creator endorsement. Preserve credits for CC0 as project policy, although CC0 does not require attribution.

Indicate OGG-to-MP3 conversion on all33 derivatives; the two CC BY derivatives are congusbongus.escalate and congusbongus.the-demon-king. Source hashes/recipes remain in the pinned manifest and derivative receipts.
Do not label all70 public domain or claim Content ID clearance. No subjective musical, mix, cultural or loop acceptance is established.
